name: Spatial-CAPTCHA-bench
description: Spatial-CAPTCHA-bench measures a model's ability to interpret CAPTCHA-like visual stimuli that require spatial reasoning and object localization under distortions. It evaluates how well vision models can recognize spatial relationships and recover semantic content from intentionally obfuscated images. The benchmark is intended to probe robustness and spatial understanding rather than general object recognition.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed HF benchmark with limited adoption outside robustness and CAPTCHA-solving research.
